preconditions.description: The number of elements n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
Both arrays a and b have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a) and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in arrays a and b are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == min(base_sum, min(base_sum - abs(a[i]-b[i]) - abs(a[j]-b[j]) + abs(a[i]-b[j]) + abs(a[j]-b[i]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible sum of absolute differences, achieved either by performing no swaps or by swapping exactly one pair of elements (i, j) in array b to minimize the total sum.
